think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s normal numeric domain and meaning. 2) Check PostgreSQL documentation for any sentinel/special numeric values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch the parameter into a qualitatively different mode (disable/enable auto/override). 3) Determine whether using that value breaks the natural ordering semantics (i.e., it’s not just ‘smaller’ or ‘larger’ but changes behavior class). 4) If such a sentinel exists, classify as special and record the special value(s); otherwise classify as non-special.
